sum: Reynolds Consumer Products Inc. produces and sells products in cooking, serving, cleanup, and storage, and tableware product categories in the United States and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Reynolds Cooking & Kitchen Essentials, Hefty Waste & Clean-Up, Hefty Home & Tableware, and Hefty Storage & Organization. The Reynolds Cooking & Kitchen Essentials produces branded and store brand aluminum foil, disposable aluminum pans, parchment paper, freezer paper, wax paper, butcher paper, plastic wrap, baking cups, oven bags and slow cooker liners; Branded products are sold under Reynolds Wrap, Reynolds KITCHENS and EZ Foil in the United States and selected international markets, under ALCAN in Canada, and under Diamond outside North America. The Hefty Waste & Clean-Up produces branded and store brand trash bags; Branded products are sold under Hefty Ultra Strong, Hefty Strong, Hefty Essentials, and Brute in the U.S. and select international markets. The Hefty Home & Tableware sells branded and store brand disposable and compostable plates, bowls, platters, containers, cups and cutlery. The Hefty Storage & Organization produces branded and store brand food storage bags; Branded products are sold under the Hefty brand in the U.S., and internationally as Reynolds, Diamond, or Hefty Basics depending on region. This segment also includes the specialty business providing Fresh-Lock and Slide-Rite resealable closure systems. Reynolds Consumer Products Inc. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois. Reynolds Consumer Products Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Packaging Finance Limited.
